title: Sweet Alma, church bazaar and priests at St. John
summary: Mrs. Clementin tells of a church bazaar that raised $20,000, a woman who prayed there, and priests; Allen recalls bass player Louis James.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
